title_sq: Apartament 3+1 ne shitje prane vilave Gjermane ne Tirane (ID 4131154)
description_sq:
Prane vilave Gjermane shitet apartament 3+1, i mobiluar, siperfaqa totale 154 m² (144 m² neto), kati 9 ne nje pallat te ri me ashensor. Apartamenti organizohet ne nje dhome ndenje te madhe dhe me kend kuzhine, 3 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete (njeri me hidromasazh), nje ballkon i madh me fushepamje dhe me diell gjate gjithe dites fale pozicionit jug-perendim. I gjithe apartamenti eshte i shtruar me tubacion per sistem chiller. Ndodhet ne nje zone te qete te Tiranes larg zhurmave dhe pluhurit.
Cmimi 200000 euro
title_en: 3+1 apartment for sale near German villas in Tirana (ID 4131154)
description_en: Near German villas, 3+1 apartment for sale, furnished, total area 154 m² (net 144 m²), 9th floor in a new building with elevator. The apartment is organized in a large living room with kitchenette, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms (one with hydromassage), a large balcony with a view of the field and with sun all day long thanks to the south-west position. The whole apartment is laid with pipes for a chiller system. It is located in a quiet area of ​​Tirana away from noise and dust. The price is 200,000 euros
